name: brew-console-tests
description: Testlaag voor brewconsole_v2_2.html — geen build/publish-package, puur het testfundament (zie tests/load-app.mjs).

scripts.qa:dist: node scripts/build.mjs dist-oud && BREWCONSOLE_APP_HTML=dist-oud/index.html node --test tests/adversarial-robustness.test.mjs tests/brewconsole.pure-logic.test.mjs tests/kernflow.smoke.test.mjs
scripts.e3:build: esbuild engine3/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=engine3/dist/engine3.mjs && esbuild engine3/sync/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=engine3/dist/sync-client.mjs && esbuild engine3/sync/worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=engine3/dist/sync-worker.mjs && esbuild engine3/qr/decode.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=engine3/dist/qr.mjs
scripts.e3:check: npm run e3:typecheck && npm run e3:test && npm run e3:build && node engine3/scripts/smoke-bundle.mjs
scripts.app3:check: npm run app3:typecheck && npm run app3:test
